description:
NeNe Folio is a simple Markdown notebook for Windows.
Keep everyday notes, reading journals, and work ideas organized in categories. Mermaid flowcharts and sequence diagrams you write in a note appear as diagrams right on the page.

WRITE AND READ
Edit plain Markdown and switch to a reading view with headings, lists, tables, quotes, and code blocks. Supported code languages use basic syntax colors. Keep your note list beside the page, or give the note more room with a dedicated view.

MERMAID DIAGRAMS
Write Mermaid in a code block marked mermaid, and the reading view shows it as a flowchart or sequence diagram. Draw flows with branches and loops back, subgraphs, messages between participants, notes, and loop or alternative frames. Diagrams follow the colors of the current theme, and the note text appears first while diagrams are completed in turn. Showing a diagram runs no scripts and makes no network requests. The Mermaid source stays in your note as written.

PICTURES
Display PNG and JPEG images from local files or HTTPS links. Remote images require a connection to their HTTPS host.

FIND WHAT YOU NEED
Filter notes by name and content, search within the open note, and use regular expressions to replace text in the editor.

ORGANIZE AND REVISIT
Choose colors for categories and drag notes to reorder them. Keep up to five previous versions when saving, and restore a version from history into the editor.

IMPORT AND EXPORT
Import UTF-8 Markdown files or export the current note as Markdown. Export saved notes as a ZIP that can include referenced local images. ZIP export excludes settings and saved history; back up the entire note folder to keep those as well.

MAKE IT YOUR OWN
Preview a wide selection of themes, including light and dark styles. Adjust text zoom, use a minimap, show editor line numbers, and find actions with keyboard shortcuts or the command palette.

Notes are stored as Markdown files in a folder you choose. No account is required, and the app has no advertising or usage analytics. The interface supports English, Japanese, and Simplified Chinese.

Requires Windows 10 version 2004 or later, x64.
HTML rendering and built-in cloud synchronization are not supported. Image formats are limited to PNG and JPEG. Mermaid support covers a subset of flowchart and sequence-diagram syntax; other diagram types, such as class diagrams and Gantt charts, are not supported.
features: Read and edit Markdown with headings, lists, tables, quotes, and basic code syntax colors
Show Mermaid flowcharts and sequence diagrams inside your notes, in the colors of the current theme
Display PNG and JPEG images from local files or HTTPS links
Import and export Markdown; export saved notes and optional referenced local images as ZIP
Organize notes with category colors and drag to reorder
Search note names and contents; replace text using regular expressions
Keep up to five previous versions and restore from saved history
Preview themes, adjust text zoom, use a minimap, and show editor line numbers
Choose a storage folder; use the interface in English, Japanese, or Simplified Chinese
shortDescription: Markdown notes with categories, search, saved history, images, and Mermaid flowcharts and sequence diagrams. Keep everyday ideas in your own folder and choose a theme that suits your writing.
